entries.title: PostReady: carousel photo upload no longer refused
entries.description: PR #958 merged: fixed a bug that caused carousel photo uploads to be refused for every customer.

entries.title: PostReady: add many files to Post Packs in one pass
entries.description: PR #957 merged: users can now add multiple files to a Post Pack in a single action, removing the one-at-a-time friction.

entries.title: PostReady: Google Business shown as connected once it is
entries.description: PR #956 merged: fixed the dashboard so Google Business Profile correctly reports as connected after OAuth, rather than showing disconnected.

entries.title: PostReady: photos attached in Prompt Studio now reach the image model
entries.description: PR #954 merged: images attached in Prompt Studio are now passed to the vision model, enabling photo-aware label and caption generation.

entries.title: PostReady: Prompt Studio no longer forbids the label it was asked to describe
entries.description: PR #953 merged: fixed Prompt Studio blocking the very label it was instructed to produce.

entries.title: PostReady: reproduce label from reference photo instead of blanking it
entries.description: PR #952 merged: fixed bug where a reference photo would blank the label instead of reproducing it correctly.

entries.title: PostReady: brand kit save fix
entries.description: PR #951 merged: stop the brand kit from reporting a successful save that never actually happened.

entries.title: PostReady: reference photo explainer copy
entries.description: PR #950 merged: clarify plainly what a reference photo does and what it does not do in the UI.

entries.title: PostReady: Threads channel live — Meta approved all permissions
entries.description: PR #949 merged: Meta approved threads_basic and threads_content_publish eight days early. All seven existing Instagram and Facebook permissions renewed in the same submission.

entries.title: PostReady: prerender public pages + static HTML deploy
entries.description: PRs #947-948 merged: marketing and auth pages now served as static HTML; remaining public pages prerendered. Performance + reliability improvements.
